description.narrative: Outcome 1 focuses on increasing the education infrastructure capacities in those regions which host large numbers of SuTPs. In order to support Trkiye in providing education to all children, the Action addresses the identified shortage in education infrastructure, by constructing additional preschools in those provinces most in need. Along with a quantitative target of additional capacities provided, the Action also focuses on enhancing the standard designs applied for school construction in order to provide for safe, resilient and childfriendly learning environments.

title.narrative: 2 2. Demonstrated improved capacity of MoNE to design and build schools which incorporate international best practiceal public

description.narrative: Outcome 2 seeks to support the MoNEProject Implementation Unit (MoNEPIU) in handling the daytoday project management. As the Action foresees the construction of a large number of education facilities (approximately 181 facilities), the PIU, who acts as the employer for construction works and consultancy services, is responsible for the management and supervision of the respective contracts. To be in the position to fulfil this role, MoNEs staff capacities shall be strengthened. In addition, the Action shall provide support to the MoNEPIU with regards to covering operational expenditures resulting from tasks associated with project implementation. Furthermore, the Action aims at supporting the development and implementation of enhanced school designs including through knowledge exchange and consultation processes with education experts, engineers as well as the target group.
